main_text.p: תָּרִיץ Ch.& Syr.Dirigere, Lucę 3.4.& 1.79. Dirigere se, Jobi 33.27: Recta ire, pergere, contendere, Act.16.11.Lucę 8.33: Rectificare, corrigere, emendare, In præfat. Testam. Viennen. de erratis Typographþ. Pahel תָּרִיץ Rectificavit, rectavit, direxit, recta deduxit, rectum fecit, æquavit.
תָּרִיץ Ch.& Syr.Rectus, rectum. Plur. תְּרִיצִין. Fœmin. תְּרִיצְתָא, תְּרִיצְתָא Recta. Plur. תְּרִיצָן, תְּרִיצָתָא.
תְּרִיצָאִירת Ch.& Syr. Recte, Prov.23.31. Lucæ 7.43. & 10.28. Recta, Act.21.1.
תרק תַּרְקָיָא Turcia. In Targ.Hier: Item nomen lapidis pretiosi, quem quidam Achatem esse volunt, Exo.28. quomodo & טַרְקָיָא interpretantur.
תשע תִּשְׁעָא Ch.& Syr.Novem.Fœmin. תִּשְׁעַ: Plur. תִּשְׁעִין תִּשְׁעָתִי Nonaginta.
תשיעי תְּשִׁיעָאָה, תְּשִׁיעִי Ch.Nonus. Fœmin. תְּשִׁיעִיתָא.
תתא תַּתָּא Vide supra in תאן.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed as far as legible; the Syriac lines at the foot of the page are not clearly readable and are omitted. Catchword line "LLII 2" is the gathering signature at the foot.
